# Incident report: checkout failures (2026-11-05)

## Summary
Customers saw failed checkouts from about 14:02 UTC. The cause was the `tax_engine_v2` feature flag, which was ramped from 10% to 100% on payments-api at 14:02 (flg_2210). Calls from payments-api to tax-service `/v2/quote` timed out, and `POST /charge` returned 502s. We set the flag back to 10% at about 14:27. Error rates returned to normal by 14:30 UTC.

## Impact
- checkout-web 5xx rate: ~17.6% from 14:03 to ~14:29 (normal baseline ~0.3%)
- payments-api error rate: ~18.3% over the same window (baseline ~0.2%)
- payments-api p99 latency: ~3150 ms (baseline ~420 ms)
- Severity: SEV1 (checkout/payment failures well above 10% of traffic)

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41 payments-api v2.14.0 deployed (dep_7781). Metrics were normal afterwards, so it was not the cause.
- 14:02 tax_engine_v2 flag ramped 10% -> 100% (flg_2210). First TaxEngineV2 timeouts logged at 14:02:31.
- 14:03 payments-api p99 alert fires. checkout-web error rate jumps to 17.6%.
- 14:04 first `POST /charge 502: tax quote unavailable` logged.
- 14:06 checkout-web 5xx alert fires.
- 14:21 incident response started. Cause identified as flg_2210 (log lines match, timing matches).
- 14:27 tax_engine_v2 set back to 10% (the previous rollout). Propagation takes about 2 minutes.
- 14:28 status page: identified.
- 14:30 checkout-web error rate 0.4%, payments-api 0.3%.
- 14:32 payments-api p99 450 ms.
- 14:30 status page: mitigated.

## Root cause
The `tax_engine_v2` ramp to 100% sent all checkout traffic through TaxEngineV2, which calls tax-service `/v2/quote`. That path timed out after 3000 ms, and payments-api returned 502 on `/charge`. The timing matches the onset of the errors, and the logs name TaxEngineV2 and `/v2/quote` directly.

Ruled out:
- dep_7781 (payments-api v2.14.0, 13:41): metrics were normal for 20 minutes after it.
- cfg_0412 (tax-service DB pool 50 -> 80, 13:15, jsato): before the error onset and no alerts on tax-service. Its exact effect on the `/v2/quote` timeouts was not tested. Worth a follow-up with tax-platform.
- dep_7790 (search-api v5.2.1, 14:05): search-api error rate stayed at 0.1%. Only a latency warning is open (see follow-up).

## Mitigation
Reverted `tax_engine_v2` from 100% to 10%, the rollout before the change. This is the least risky step under the runbook. No deploys were rolled back.

## Verification
- checkout-web error rate: 17.6% -> 0.4% (14:30), under the 1% threshold.
- payments-api error rate: 18.3% -> 0.3% (14:30).
- payments-api p99: 3150 ms -> 450 ms (14:32).
- Only the search-api p95 latency warning (alt_33) remains open. Its error rate is 0.1%.

Recovery is verified on error rate and latency. The flag is still at 10%, so about 10% of traffic still uses the tax engine path. The 14:30 numbers were measured after the flag change took effect.

## Teams paged and communications
- payments (high urgency): paged with the root cause and mitigation. Ack received.
- Status page: identified at 14:28, mitigated at 14:30 (SEV1).
- Not paged: tax-platform. Tax-service has no alerts and no errors of its own. Recommend notifying them as a courtesy.
- Security: no credentials or secrets seen in logs.

## Open items / follow-ups
1. payments team: fix the TaxEngineV2 timeouts against tax-service `/v2/quote` before re-ramping the flag. Consider a shorter timeout and a fallback to the v1 tax path so one slow dependency can't fail `/charge`.
2. Don't re-ramp tax_engine_v2 until the change is reviewed. The release-train ramp went from 10% to 100% in one step, with no gradual steps.
3. tax-platform: check `/v2/quote` latency and capacity. Confirm whether cfg_0412 (DB pool 50 -> 80, 13:15) has any effect.
4. search-api: p95 latency warning open since 14:09 (deploy dep_7790 at 14:05). Investigate separately. It is not the cause of the checkout errors.
5. Post-incident review.
